== Description ==
'''GAMMA-2''' is the 2nd varint of [[SHA-2]], being admin-exclusive

== Behavior ==
Once spawned, it will place itself behiend the door, just like [[SHA-2]], but will fall back faster and will rebound a couple times, it will make whispering sounds when it despawns.

== Strategy & Tips ==

* just hide when you see the screen shake
